entities.name: Recin
entities.description: A Garan Elf of Berimish in Tamingazin, Otaria, who helped retrieve the Magewall Hub.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: City in Tamingazin where Recin lived.

entities.name: Janin
entities.description: Recin's mother, gar of the Garan, who arrived in Berimish as a refugee.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Led an army that bloodlessly claimed Berimish.

entities.name: Tallibeth Tarngold
entities.description: Tagard's daughter who recruited Recin to learn the city's layout.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Cast a sleep spell on Berimish.

entities.name: Bey Lisolo
entities.description: Ruler of Berimish whose torc Tagard took.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Ambassador who let the invaders into the palace; killed by Recin.

entities.name: Kitrin
entities.description: Envoy of the Institute of Arcane Study who proved Recin's innocence and killed Hemarch Solin.

entities.name: Oesol
entities.description: Envoy of the Institute of Arcane Study.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: Institution that sent envoys to Berimish.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Army that held the Magewall Hub.

entities.name: Samet
entities.description: New gar who honored Recin with the name kan.

events.summary: Tagard's army approached Berimish; Aligarius's sleep spell knocked out the city, and Tagard took the torc from Lisolo in a bloodless coup.
events.quote: Tagard took the torc from the sleeping Lisolo, and thus claimed Berimish in a bloodless coup.

events.summary: Recin was falsely accused of the king's murder and imprisoned until Kitrin and Oesol proved his innocence.
events.quote: Recin was falsely accused of being the killer himself and thrown into a dockside prison cell.

events.summary: During Karelon's coup, Rael Gar was killed and Samet honored Recin with the name kan.
events.quote: Rael Gar , who had aggressively pushed for Recin's execution, was killed

events.summary: Kitrin killed Hemarch Solin by throwing her tracking crystal as a dagger.
events.quote: she managed to kill the Suderbod leader by using her tracking crystal as a throwing dagger.

events.summary: Recin killed Ursal Daleel and his guard in the bayou, and the group escaped with the Magewall Hub.
events.quote: Recin managed to kill both Ursal and his guard
